target: run-stop judgement on nidana.tooling D1, and the next steps

decisions.question: S23 decomposed nidana.tooling into two leaf-parents, nidana.tooling.codegen (about nine phases) and nidana.tooling.lint (about three), with nidana-checks@v1 produced by both; the alternative is one leaf-parent of about twelve phases. Is this the tree-shape run-stop?

options.label: Not a stop; accept two children
options.consequence: Two phase plans, planned independently; nidana-checks@v1 has two producing nodes, each replaying its own host's cases; reconcile applies the union of their produced_by confirms.

options.label: Not a stop; one leaf-parent
options.consequence: One plan of about twelve phases spanning two packages with different hosts and toolchains (a build_runner package and an analysis server plugin pinned to an exact analyzer).

options.label: Stop the run
options.consequence: The owner decides; only the tooling phase plans wait.

decisions.chosen: Not a stop; accept two children
decisions.why: The test that kept nidana.runtime whole, whether a boundary needs an internal contract that could never be stable, passes here: the two packages share no code (ADR-002 item 4: the plugin depends on no nidana package), so no internal contract is needed, and ADR-002 item 3 already gives each package one owning node. HSDD's leaf-parent rule and its tip to add a level past a handful of phases both favour two children. That is a stated reason for one option, so the shape stop does not hold under DEC-002's reading.

decisions.question: S23 recommends two ADR touches (ADR-001 item 10 for a contract two leaf-parents produce; ADR-002's stale 'Plugin rules report at INFO severity', which nidana-checks@v1 G1 contradicts for three rules) and lists what the root refresh must restate. Run the ADR touches before phase planning, or leave them to reconcile?

options.label: Before phase planning
options.consequence: Two small hsdd-adr steps, then the root refresh; phase plans and the phase contexts hsdd-config later injects read ADRs that match the contracts.

options.label: Leave to reconcile
options.consequence: Phase planners read an ADR-001 item 10 whose 'last phase that produces the contract' has no single reading for nidana-checks@v1, and an ADR-002 consequence that contradicts a contract both lint phases will consume.

decisions.why: hsdd-config injects an ADR's Decision and Consequences into every phase context it governs; a stale or ambiguous line there reaches every implementing session. Reconcile drains only what phase plans emit, and no plan owns an ADR. The cost is two short steps.
